#  Agentic. Generative. Search 
One AI retrieval platform to power them all
[ Explore the platform  ](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai)
##  Powering AI retrieval across use cases
More than 18,000 customers across 150+ countries use Algolia to power agentic, generative, and search experiences across these use cases and more.
  * Product Discovery
Help users find the right products instantly with retrieval that identifies relevant items and features—like filtering, facets, and business rules—that optimize results for the KPIs you care about most. [Learn more](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai-search).
  * Generative AI
Ensure every AI response is accurate and on-brand with RAG that grounds outputs in your verified data and stays consistent with your search logic. [Learn more](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai/generative-experiences).
  * Guided Shopping
Guide shoppers to a confident purchase faster with intent-aware retrieval that adapts to their needs instantly. [Learn more](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai/agent-studio "agent-studio").
  * Merchandising
Adjust how products appear across category and collection pages. Pin items, promote campaigns, or adapt ranking strategies without engineering support. [Learn more](https://www.algolia.com/industries/ecommerce/digital-merchandising).


[ See more capabilities ](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai)

Yourcustomers get relevant results to find precisely what they’re looking for — in milliseconds.
